init_TestTaskSL: create a TestTaskSL instance that moves a module to a device and sets it to eval mode
set_test_params: call set_test_params to parse task sensor ckpt and dataset name then create output directories
run_model: run the model on a dataset and dataloader by subclassing TestTaskSL and implementing run_model
get_overall_metrics: get overall metrics from a dataset by subclassing TestTaskSL and implementing get_overall_metrics
make_plots: make plots from a dataset by subclassing TestTaskSL and implementing make_plots with optional params
